nodes.text: The Tutorial
John Faust is already lingering in the lobby. Jacob and Wagner pop into view. A cute secretary is typing at her console.
Greetings gentlemen. My name is Olivia and I am here to help you adjust to your new equipment.
What are you, AI, avatar?

I am a very real person. The equipment goggles we gave you include projection windows into other dimensions. These office spaces were carved out of imagination, but occupy a very real volume in space-time.
There are quite a few software level functions to allow you to adjust these realities, but keep in mind you will only affect the rules of the world itself and not its inhabitants.
There are ways to do just that, but not within the legal confines of our hardware, so you'll have to get crafty all on your lonesome.
Impressive.
Try adjusting your viewpoint to Empathetic.
The boys do.
As Olivia speaks, her words break up and become a bit scrambled. Her speech is subtitled.
Notice how you hear one thing, but what I'm saying is actually quite different from how you perceive it.
As much as I love my job, today is not a good day for me to be here. My pet cat is sick and I'm worrying about her a great deal. My mom's phone call last night gave me nightmares.
Jacob looks at his brother and smiles.
I can say just how much I love you man, and you will truly know I mean it.
That goes without saying. Empathetic mode is only going to give us super powers.
Yeah, I feel the world heating up. Got to be careful with that button.
Now switch the channel to Target Demographic.

opts.text: Stay in Empathetic a moment longer.

nodes.text: For a moment longer, the lobby hums with everything nobody in it is saying.
They do.
Here you will see the world as a product being designed and sold by invisible hands. People will reek of corporate identification and speak their affiliation.
They watch a television program.
A sitcom family relates its day in the products it consumed and the interests it has in coming products. It's horrifying.
There are millions of other possible filters or windows into these realities. Be careful which doors you open, because if you're not strong or careful, you might not return.
Jesus. I think staring into the multiverse may be blinding.
Oh, that is for certain. But think of the sights we'll see.
My head was starting to hurt, but now I think in a good way.
The boys stand up, take off their goggles.
I think I'm going to need a drink.
